name: siwithben-plugins
description: Practical plugins for Claude Code and Claude Cowork, for project managers and busy professionals, by Benjamin Vermeulen (@SIwithBen).

plugins.name: pm-status-report
plugins.description: Turn rough project notes into a consistent, executive-ready weekly status report with a RAG rating.

plugins.name: pm-toolkit
plugins.description: Project charter, WBS with PERT estimates, risk register, executive translator, project summary, weekly priorities, risk update, stakeholder email and Gantt chart (HTML, Excel, PowerPoint) skills for project managers.

plugins.name: claude-setup-kit
plugins.description: Set Claude up in 7 steps: global, project and folder (CLAUDE.md) instruction templates, a PM project folder creator and a setup check with a scorecard.

plugins.name: task-tracker
plugins.description: One task tracker (TASKS.md) for committed actions from Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, Notion, ClickUp and meeting notes: sweep, morning brief, and a tick-box dashboard whose changes you paste back.

plugins.name: ai-pm-project-plan
plugins.description: Project Plan Generator: a client-ready Gantt, milestone tracker and status snapshot as Excel, HTML, PowerPoint and PDF, from a project brief or your PM tool. Lives in its own public repo.
